ICHIGO_REIRYOKU.title: Reiryoku
ICHIGO_REIRYOKU.description:
At 100 [gold]Reiryoku[/gold], transform into [gold]True Bankai[/gold] or [gold]Bankai: Horn of Salvation[/gold].
Gain 5 Reiryoku at the start of each turn, 3 when you play an Attack, and 6 when you play a [gold]Getsuga[/gold] card.
Attacking a creature with [gold]Spiritual Pressure[/gold] increases Reiryoku gained from Attacks and Getsuga cards by 3.
